criteria.description: `parseProductQuery` in `src/utils/queryParser.ts` must set `query.featured = true` when the raw query string contains `featured=true`, and `query.featured = false` when it contains `featured=false`. Any other value must leave `query.featured` undefined.
criteria.evidence: File inspection of src/benchmark-backend/src/utils/queryParser.ts lines 22-26: `if (raw.featured === 'true') { query.featured = true; } else if (raw.featured === 'false') { query.featured = false; }` — maps string 'true'/'false' to booleans; any other value (absent, etc.) leaves query.featured undefined. All three 'Featured filter' tests PASSED (vitest run: 23 passed (23), exit code 0).

criteria.description: `getAllProducts` in `src/services/productService.ts` must filter the result set to products where `(p.featured ?? false) === query.featured` when `query.featured` is defined.
criteria.evidence: File inspection of src/benchmark-backend/src/services/productService.ts lines 23-25: `if (query.featured !== undefined) { result = result.filter((p) => (p.featured ?? false) === query.featured); }` — exact expression matches requirement. Tests 'Featured filter > returns only featured products when featured=true', 'Featured filter > returns only non-featured products when featured=false', and 'Featured filter > featured=true combined with category filter returns intersection' all PASSED (vitest run: 23 passed (23), exit code 0).

criteria.description: `getAllProducts` in `src/services/productService.ts` must sort results by `rating` descending (`b.rating - a.rating`) when `query.sort === 'rating_desc'`. The sort must not mutate the source array (use a derived copy).
criteria.evidence: File inspection of src/benchmark-backend/src/services/productService.ts lines 35-37: `else if (query.sort === 'rating_desc') { result = [...result].sort((a, b) => b.rating - a.rating); }` — uses spread copy `[...result]` (non-mutating) and comparator `b.rating - a.rating` (descending). Test 'Rating sort > sorts by rating descending when sort=rating_desc' PASSED (vitest run: 23 passed (23), exit code 0).
